parole.significato: dwarf (various senses), midget, gnome, pygmy, manikin, elf
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech karel, karlík or Polish karlę, karzeł, karlik, all from Old High German karal, whence Middle High German karl (“little boy”) and German Kerl (“young man”). Ultimately from Proto-Germanic *karilaz.

parole.significato: contemporary, age-mate (one who is the same age as another)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Czech rovesník or Polish rówieśnik.
